requirements.description: Big Six Wheel exposes the approved 54-segment profile, seven wager targets, deterministic result seam, and documented net payout table through its engine and browser surface.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #86; focused tests cover all legal targets, segment boundaries, normalization, and payout calculation.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Big Six Wheel state, recent settlements, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Normal-user session context overrides caller-supplied player ids, and settled round history survives backend restart.

requirements.description: Each Big Six spin uses one aggregate ledger wager debit and at most one settlement credit with request-fingerprint conflict detection and exactly-once retry recovery.
requirements.notes: Game code never mutates balances directly; stable round and ledger action keys make exact retries safe while changed wagers fail closed.

requirements.description: The Big Six Wheel surface provides complete English and Russian copy, responsive ready/spinning/settled states, cumulative forward wheel motion, delayed result reveal, and reduced-motion-safe timer lifecycle behavior.
requirements.notes: Acceptance evidence covers both locales, all four named viewports, active and settled play, cumulative pointer alignment, reduced motion, and canonical route restoration.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery automatically include Big Six Wheel with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 90 and the normalized tests.game_drivers.big_six_wheel:play driver reference reserved by issue #77.

requirements.description: Every normal Big Six spin advances cumulatively through at least six clockwise turns, keeps the authoritative outcome hidden and wager controls locked until presentation settles, and lands the fixed pointer on the server-selected segment without snap, reset, reverse, or stale lifecycle state.
requirements.notes: The exact-head long gate performs 100 consecutive real UI spins at each governed viewport, covers EN/RU, resize, background/foreground lifecycle suspension, four-times CPU throttling, reduced motion, cache-safe production asset reload, scroll reachability, and paired top/stage/lower visual review.
